title: Chromefile
description: Declarative desired state for Google Chrome and Chromium-based browsers. See https://github.com/whirlwin/chromefile/blob/main/SPEC.md

version.description: Chromefile specification version this file conforms to. Tools must refuse versions they do not support.

layout.description: Where the tab strip is shown. vertical: along the side of the window. horizontal: across the top of the window.

duplicates.description: What happens when a new tab loads a page another tab in the same profile already shows. ask: the new tab offers to close the older tab or tabs, never closing one without confirmation; URLs are compared without the fragment and pinned tabs are never offered. allow: nothing special happens.

hotkeys.description: Keyboard shortcuts. Keys are action names from the action registry, values are key combinations (or a per-platform mapping). An empty string means the action has no hotkey.

propertyNames.description: Action name from the action registry.

tab.next.description: Activate the tab after the active one in tab strip order (below in vertical layout, to the right in horizontal layout), wrapping from last to first, within the current window.

tab.previous.description: Activate the tab before the active one in tab strip order (above in vertical layout, to the left in horizontal layout), wrapping from first to last, within the current window.

combo.description: Key combination: one or more modifiers (Command, Ctrl, Alt, Shift, MacCtrl) joined with '+', then exactly one key, for example Command+J or Ctrl+Shift+Y. At least one modifier other than Shift is required, no modifier may repeat, and Command and Ctrl must not be combined. An empty string means no hotkey.

hotkey.description: A key combination for every platform, or a mapping from platform (mac, windows, linux, default) to key combination.

oneOf.description: Per-platform key combinations. 'default' applies to platforms not listed.

default.description: Key combination on platforms not listed.
